No departments/teams/reporting-line table exists in supabase/migrations (profiles has only region text and org_scope text; roles/user_roles has no manager_id or department_id column). The department_team and manager_persona_id columns above are DESIGN-INTENDED values, not backed by a schema column today. Two options for the eventual seeder: (a) request a change-controlled profiles.manager_user_id + a minimal departments/teams table, or (b) encode department/manager informally inside profiles.org_scope as a structured string until a schema decision is made. Do not invent a table name and seed against it without this decision.

factory_representatives (0011_factory360_gis_ksa_seed.sql) is the only external-contact-style table; there is no portal login for factory representatives (no factory_rep auth.users rows), so 'factory_rep' role (seeded in roles table, 0001_foundation.sql) currently has no persona instance. This plan intentionally seeds factory contacts only into factory_representatives, not as auth-authenticated personas, until a factory-portal login contract exists.
